items.source: Sina Tech (新浪科技/新浪新闻)
items.title: 其他奢侈品牌如Gucci在中国销量表现如何？
items.summary: Chinese business-media comparative analysis: Gucci has posted eleven consecutive quarters of sales decline in China, with estimated annual China sales falling from roughly RMB 100 billion at 2022 peak to about RMB 40 billion in 2026, now potentially trailing Prada. Attributes the slide to weakened brand strength, repeated creative-director turnover, and eroded consumer loyalty, while noting Chinese shoppers increasingly favor cultural authenticity over logo prestige. Independent critical analysis, not activation coverage. Slightly outside the ideal 72-hour window but retained as the most substantive recent China-specific critical piece; corroborates the 2026-08-23 pool's tax-crackdown and 12-quarter-decline items with an even sharper revenue-collapse framing.

items.source: Sina Finance (新浪财经, via k.sina.cn)
items.title: 开云突发预警古驰销售暴跌，是奢侈品卖不动还是衣服太难看？
items.summary: Aggregated Xiaohongshu (RED) consumer commentary cited in Chinese financial media: users say a Gucci 1955 bag's secondhand price fell from roughly RMB 13,000 to RMB 6,500, and some comment that RMB 20,000 spent on travel would create better memories than a Gucci bag, or that buying secondhand at half price is smarter than buying new. Captures genuine consumer skepticism/resale-price erosion sentiment rather than brand-sourced marketing; critical-angle signal.

items.title: 樋口可弥子やアノック・ヤイもキャンペーンに登場。グッチの新作バッグ「レディ ルネッタ」に注目！
items.summary: Gucci launched chapter two of its Summer 2026 campaign (Monaco hotel/villa/motorcycle settings) featuring models Anok Yai, Kayako Higuchi, Tian Siwei and Amelia Grey, centered on the new Lady Lunetta bag (JPY 286,000-335,500) and the 60th-anniversary Flora motif originally designed for Princess Grace of Monaco. Descriptive product/campaign coverage -- activation_coverage, no independent evaluative verdict.

items.title: 구찌, 신세계 강남 '구찌 에디터룸' 7월 30일 오픈…익스클루시브 컬렉션 공개
items.summary: Gucci opened a pop-up called 'Gucci Editor Room' at Shinsegae Department Store Gangnam (The Stage, 1F), running July 30-August 9, showing womenswear, menswear, handbags including Jackie, Borsetto and Paparazzo, plus pop-up-exclusive items. Retail-activation announcement -- activation_coverage. Included for regional retail-presence context despite running slightly before the 72h window; no fresher independent NEA retail item surfaced today.

items.title: 중고명품 리셀은... 매입처가 진짜 문제 아닐까요?
items.summary: Korean secondhand-luxury reseller post arguing that the widely reported 'resale is no longer profitable' narrative (which explicitly cites Gucci and other luxury brands amid the broader Korean luxury-resale market downturn) is really a wholesale-sourcing margin problem rather than pure demand collapse. Independent trade-community commentary reflecting eroding confidence in the resale channel; engagement counts not visible on the fetched page.

items.title: 중고시장 뜨는데 중고 명품은 외면…신뢰 잃은 '럭셔리 리셀'의 추락
items.summary: Korean media report: while general secondhand fashion trading is booming, dedicated luxury-resale platforms are contracting, hurt by inflated pricing, counterfeit concerns and eroding brand trust; cites falling global resale premiums (Patek Philippe -22%, Cartier -11%, Rolex -7% YoY) as part of a broader luxury-resale value decline affecting brands including Gucci. Independent critical market-structure signal; corroborates item 005's resale-market skepticism from the trade side.

items.title: 에스파 닝닝, '인간 구찌'로 거듭나나…앰버서더 됐다 [공식]
items.summary: aespa's Ningning was named a Gucci global brand ambassador; she said she is 'thrilled and excited' since Gucci was a brand she admired since childhood, and fan attention is building around her future looks for the house. Fandom/ambassador enthusiasm -- per sentiment rubric, magnitude damped as it reflects fan excitement rather than independent critical judgment. Kept despite age as the most substantial K-ambassador SNS-adjacent item found for the NEA pool this cycle; flagged as stale (well past the 72h target, though inside the 14-day hard ceiling) -- treat as lower weight and prioritize replacing with fresher ambassador content next cycle.
